f.t: BD launches Liverty TIPS stent graft in the USA
f.x: BD (Becton, Dickinson) has announced the US commercial launch of its BD Liverty transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) stent graft. According to the company, the next-generation TIPS system is designed to give physicians greater flexibility to tailor treatment for patients with portal hypertension.
